Strategy: Count-parity gate: with an odd number of feasible bins use worst fit, preferring the largest residual, and with an even number use tightest fit; the parity of the open-bin count switches the packing mode, spreading items when the pool is odd-sized and consolidating when it is even. It can fail when parity has no real link to packing state and the mode flips add only noise.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(r if len(bins) % 2 == 1 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
